candidates.prompt: Create ONE square 1024x1024 SEAMLESS repeatable old WOODEN HARBOR DECK ground ALBEDO / DIFFUSE BASE COLOR texture. Perfectly flat orthographic top-down, no perspective, no horizon, no camera tilt, no board stack, no material sphere and no scene. The entire square is filled by level parallel long wood planks whose length and fine grain run VERTICALLY from the top to bottom of the image. This is a reusable plane material for a bright miniature old Chinese red-cliff seaport at sunset: boats and orange-red evening light are in the game, NOT in the texture. Material itself is clean, warm, medium-to-light in value and comfortably readable, no dark cyberpunk grading. Repeat continuously in BOTH directions; the same plank spacing, gap width, wood tone and grain scale must meet at opposite edges, with no frame or wide edge stripe. VERTICAL board boundaries are narrow, subdued warm gray-brown material-color lines, never jet-black chasms or bright-white bevels. Use largely uninterrupted long planks; do not draw horizontal crossbars, support beams, a deck border or large board end caps. Fine lengthwise grain and mild sun-weathered surface wear only; keep low-frequency variations subtle across the full image so repetition is unobtrusive. Flat uniform diffuse material color: no baked directional sun, shadow, bright bevel edge, ambient-occlusion trough, specular shine, wet reflection, global light gradient, glare or vignette. No nails, bolts, metal parts, big repeated knots, ring-shaped knot eyes, large fissures, splinter holes, black stains, mold, algae, puddles, burned wood, oil, dark purple, neon, fresh red material or blood. No text, symbols, faces, people, animals, buildings, boats, ropes, barrels, shells, leaves, objects or painted decoration. Output a single independently generated material tile, not a montage. Leave no transparency. VARIANT 1: SIX evenly spaced broad parallel long boards. Calm honey / warm old tan-brown heartwood, around #b08258 and #b58a62, with restrained muted tan #c29a72 areas, NOT deep mahogany or orange-red. Fine somewhat irregular vertical fibers, shallow worn pores and a few minute pale rubbed marks, still intact and level. Each board differs only softly in base reflectance, no alternating dark/light zebra stripes. No knots. Opposite sides both crop at the midpoint of an ordinary thin board joint, with all six board columns forming a complete repeat; top and bottom fine grain and tones continue cleanly.

limitations: 每板色差与纵向纤维会呈平行/低频重复，4x4可辨，需按实际UV尺度评估。

最不满意：细木纹在小显示足迹经缩小过滤会趋平，单板细色差随周期重复；当前GPU完整纹理足迹约307px，12列窄板约26px宽，实际地面UV由接入方评估。
